# Tom Restrepo — Head of Investor Relations

- **Relationship:** cross-org partner; runs **Investor Relations (IR)** — LP communications,
  quarterly letters, the annual meeting, and fundraising.
- **Cadence:** weekly during fundraising; monthly otherwise.
- **Owns:** the LP relationship map, including anchor LP
  [Harold Weiss](harold-weiss.md); drafts the Fund III quarterly LP letter.
- **Distinguishing fact:** keeper of every LP's side-letter terms and sector sensitivities —
  check with Tom before any LP outreach.

## How to work with him
- Loop him in before contacting any LP directly; he coordinates who says what.
